scope: Fix a real bug: extension-drive-routes.js has no CORS headers, silently blocking content.js's cross-origin auto-pickup fetch calls from any host page.

steps.title: Add CORS headers so content.js's cross-origin auto-pickup fetch actually works
steps.task: Add permissive CORS middleware (every route here already requires the secret command-key header) so content.js's fetch() from an arbitrary host page origin is not silently blocked by the browser, using PATCH MODE.
non_goals: a full-file rewrite -- use patch mode only
